meta.name: alfworld-temperature-regulator
meta.description: Manages the temperature state of an object by placing it into an appropriate appliance (fridge for cooling, microwave for heating). Use when the task requires modifying an object's temperature property, such as "cool some bread" or "heat some food". Takes the object identifier, temperature-modifying receptacle, and final target receptacle as inputs, and outputs the object at the target location with its temperature state changed.

copy.tagline: 调节物体温度状态，如冷却或加热物品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在模拟环境中改变物体温度
copy.tagline_en: Adjust object temperature state, such as cooling or heating items
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to change object temperature in a simulated environment

howto.what: 该技能让Claude可以改变物体的温度：将物体放入冰箱冷却，或放入微波炉加热，然后移动到指定位置。
howto.when: 当任务要求改变物体温度，例如“冷却面包”或“加热食物”时触发。需要提供物体、温度调节容器和最终目标容器的标识。

say.text: 请把面包放到冰箱冷却。
say.note: Claude会将面包放入冰箱后放到餐桌。

say.text: 加热一份汤并放到餐桌上。
say.note: Claude会用微波炉加热汤后放到餐桌。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to change an object's temperature by placing it in a fridge for cooling or a microwave for heating, then moving it to a specified target location.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task requires modifying an object's temperature, such as "cool some bread" or "heat some food". Requires the object, temperature-modifying receptacle, and target receptacle identifiers.

say_en.text: Please cool the bread in the fridge.
say_en.note: Claude will put the bread in the fridge then move it to the dining table.

say_en.text: Heat a bowl of soup and put it on the table.
say_en.note: Claude will heat the soup in the microwave then place it on the table.
